purpose: Manuscript-specific protocol summary and source manifest, not a replacement for the archived premeasurement timing protocol.

hardware.placement: One pinned physical core per L3 cache domain; separate coordinator domain; NUMA binding where supported with recorded fallback.

software.instrumentation_overhead: Not independently isolated; results are measurements of the instrumented copies.

inputs.GWAS: FinnGen R13 type 2 diabetes; n=486019; 99 FIN LD-reference samples
inputs.eQTL: GTEx v11 Whole_Blood; n=800; 525 EUR LD-reference samples
inputs.LD: Signed float64 PLINK reconstruction on the benchmark compute node, frozen reference samples, variants, alleles and order; checked against archived input digests.
inputs.windows: First 500, 1000, 2000, 4000, 10000 and 19221 variants of T2D_chr10_61277948_71054950; not independent loci.

timing.selection: First three retained calls for 24 initial-schedule cases; all three retained calls for 14339 others; no outcome-based selection.
timing.complete_call: Accept already loaded arrays through returned results, including validation and RSS preparation. Excludes imports, disk reads, LD reconstruction, explicit garbage collection, numerical comparison and serialization.
timing.fitting_stage: Direct same-call spans for solver initialization, IBSS/SER, convergence/ELBO and final posterior/credible-set results; excludes full input/LD preparation. Native implicit Gram scaling remains fitting work; R materializes its scaled Gram before its fitting span.
timing.paired_ratio: Per case, susieR median of three retained calls divided by prusie median of three retained calls; report the across-case median and quartiles.
timing.dataset_total: Sum of per-case medians, each analysis counted once; not sum of all repeats, a directly observed serial run or parallel campaign wall time.
timing.backend_order: Seeded balanced case-level order, sequential on the same pinned lane; no alternation between every retained repeat.

memory.reporting_status: Postmeasurement reporting of high-water marks already recorded by the primary timing harness, not a newly claimed independent memory campaign.
memory.prusie_measurement: resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss converted from KiB to bytes
memory.boundary: Per case/backend fresh process through final fit, including interpreter, libraries, input loading, warmup and retained fits; captured before numerical comparison and serialization. No reference alpha arrays are preloaded.
memory.process_calls: Four calls for 14339 cases and eight calls for 24 initial-schedule cases; a process high-water mark cannot be truncated to selected repeat timings.
memory.caveat: Not fitting-only increments or independent single-call peaks. Linux ru_maxrss may include pre-exec image residency, unlike VmHWM; that unmeasured difference could raise the prusie peak.

numerical_acceptance.comparison: Final full alpha matrix in original component/variant order; PIP differences reported separately.
numerical_acceptance.inclusion: All fixed cases retained regardless of numerical agreement, convergence or speed.
